description: This file implements a class for deduplicating module uses within a PyTorch JIT graph, including functions for analyzing and rewriting module references to avoid duplication.

classes.name: ModuleUseDeduper
classes.description: A class responsible for analyzing and deduplicating module uses within a Torch JIT module graph.

methods.name: dedup
methods.description: Performs the deduplication process on the module's methods.

methods.name: findModuleUses
methods.description: Analyzes the graph to find and record module uses for potential deduplication.

methods.name: dedupModuleUses
methods.description: Rewrites module uses to point to deduplicated clones.

methods.name: addChildModule
methods.description: Creates and registers a clone of a child module under a new name within the parent module.
